shared_elements: upright human-like figures carved in low relief
figures placed at the vertical edges flanking a central field
justification: Both surfaces combine a rectangular relief field carrying rows of inscribed signs with upright human-shaped figures in low relief set against it, which is a broadly comparable but not distinctive scheme. In B the single figure is fully legible as a winged, bearded being holding a bucket-like object and raising a hand toward a rosette-covered stylised plant, while A shows only vague eroded standing forms at the margins of a dominant text panel with no attributes, gestures, plants or wings identifiable.
